definitions.explanation: A family unit living together and the domestic life they share. Emphasizes the social and emotional aspects of family life rather than the physical building.

examples.japanese: {幸|しあわ}せな{家庭|かてい}を{築|きず}く。
{家庭|かてい}の{事情|じじょう}で{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}すことになった。
examples.english: Due to family circumstances, we had to move.

examples.japanese: {仕事|しごと}と{家庭|かてい}のバランスを{取|と}るのが{難|むずか}しいと{感|かん}じる{人|ひと}は{多|おお}い。
examples.english: Many people find it difficult to balance work and family life.

notes:
{家庭|かてい} combines {家|か} (house) and {庭|てい} (garden, grounds). It refers to the family unit and domestic life, not the physical structure.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {家庭|かてい}を{築|きず}く (to build a home/family)
- {家庭|かてい}の{事情|じじょう} (family circumstances)
- {家庭|かてい}{環境|かんきょう} (home environment)
- {家庭|かてい}{料理|りょうり} (home cooking)
- {家庭|かてい}{教師|きょうし} (private tutor — literally "home teacher")
- {家庭|かてい}{裁判所|さいばんしょ} (family court)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {家庭|かてい} vs. {家族|かぞく} vs. {家|いえ}: {家庭|かてい} emphasizes domestic life and the household as a social unit. {家族|かぞく} refers to the family members themselves. {家|いえ} can mean the physical house, the household, or a family lineage.
